notes: v200: Smoother play and fewer freezes. The map's effects layer is capped on very wide or high-resolution screens, autosaves wait for an idle moment instead of pausing the game, AI budgets are worked out once per day, panels that aren't visible no longer refresh every tick, and phones draw effects at 30 fps outside nuclear strikes. Removed the Economy, Industry, Foreign Affairs and Intelligence shortcuts from the Menu (they're still in the side panel).
